newsHighlights.title: Seven Star Crags, Zhaoqing, Guangdong
newsHighlights.summary: Zhaoqing's Seven Star Crags scenic area, where limestone peaks rise from clear lakes, is hailed as a model of balancing tourism development with ecological conservation.
newsHighlights.translation: 广东肇庆七星岩景区以湖光山色著称，被誉为平衡旅游开发与生态保护的典范。

newsHighlights.title: National Day holiday fuels tourism, culture boom
newsHighlights.summary: China's National Day holiday has fueled a surge in domestic travel and cultural consumption, with more visitors choosing low-carbon, nature-based getaways.
newsHighlights.translation: 国庆假期带动了国内旅游与文化消费热潮，越来越多游客选择低碳、亲近自然的出行方式。

newsHighlights.title: Numbers behind China's National Day holiday
newsHighlights.summary: Data from the holiday show record passenger trips and rising demand for eco-friendly tourism, underscoring the shift toward greener lifestyles.
newsHighlights.translation: 假期数据显示出行人次创纪录，生态旅游需求上升，凸显生活方式正向更绿色方向转变。

newsHighlights.title: Policy support buoys full-year growth outlook
newsHighlights.summary: Continued policy support, including investment in renewable energy and green infrastructure, has brightened China's growth outlook for the whole year.
newsHighlights.translation: 包括可再生能源与绿色基础设施投资在内的持续政策支持，提振了中国全年经济增长前景。

newsHighlights.title: Sojourn living: a fast-growing new sector
newsHighlights.summary: Long-stay 'sojourn living' in scenic towns is emerging as a fast-growing sector, encouraging slower travel that places less strain on the environment.
newsHighlights.translation: 在风景小镇长期旅居正成为快速增长的新业态，倡导节奏更慢、对环境压力更小的旅行方式。

quote.quote: The Earth is what we all have in common.
quote.author: Wendell Berry
quote.translation: 地球是我们所有人的共同家园。
quote.explanation: 这句名言强调环境是全人类共同的财富，与今日新闻中景区生态保护、绿色出行和可持续旅游的主题高度契合——无论身处何方，我们都共享同一个地球，因此保护环境是每个人的责任。

vocabulary.definition: 风景优美的；与景色有关的
vocabulary.example: The Seven Star Crags scenic area is known for its clear lakes and green karst peaks.
vocabulary.translation: 七星岩景区以其清澈的湖水和青翠的喀斯特山峰闻名。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 China Daily 报道《Seven Star Crags, Zhaoqing, Guangdong》中的 scenic area 一词。

vocabulary.definition: （对自然环境、文物等的）保护；保存
vocabulary.example: Local authorities have strengthened ecological conservation around the lakes to protect water quality.
vocabulary.translation: 当地有关部门加强了湖泊周边的生态保护，以维护水质。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自七星岩景区报道，指景区在旅游开发的同时坚持 ecological conservation。

vocabulary.definition: 原始状态的；未受破坏的；崭新的
vocabulary.example: Visitors are reminded to keep the lakes and forests in their pristine condition.
vocabulary.translation: 游客被提醒要让湖泊和森林保持原始、未受破坏的状态。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联七星岩景区新闻：景区吸引力正源于其 pristine natural landscape（未受破坏的自然景观）。

vocabulary.example: Wetlands around the crags support rich biodiversity, including many migratory birds.
vocabulary.translation: 七星岩周边湿地孕育了丰富的生物多样性，包括众多候鸟。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联七星岩生态报道：湿地与山林生态系统是维护区域 biodiversity 的关键。

vocabulary.example: More travellers are choosing sustainable ways of exploring scenic towns during the holiday.
vocabulary.translation: 越来越多游客在假期选择可持续的方式游览风景小镇。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联国庆旅游热潮报道：绿色出行与 slow travel 体现了 sustainable tourism（可持续旅游）理念。

vocabulary.example: The National Day holiday fuels a tourism and culture boom across the country.
vocabulary.translation: 国庆假期带动了全国旅游与文化的繁荣。
vocabulary.newsContext: 直接出自 China Daily 标题《National Day holiday fuels tourism, culture boom》。

vocabulary.example: The influx of holiday travellers has put pressure on popular scenic spots.
vocabulary.translation: 假期游客的大量涌入给热门景区带来了压力。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联国庆假期新闻：假期出行人次创新高，形成 visitor influx（游客涌入）。

vocabulary.example: Limiting visitor numbers helps prevent environmental degradation in fragile areas.
vocabulary.translation: 限制游客数量有助于防止生态脆弱地区的环境退化。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联景区保护与绿色政策新闻：防止 environmental degradation 是生态旅游的核心目标之一。

vocabulary.example: Investment in renewable energy has helped buoy the country's full-year growth outlook.
vocabulary.translation: 对可再生能源的投资提振了全国全年经济增长前景。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 China Daily《Policy support buoys full-year growth outlook》，政策支持涵盖 renewable energy 投资。

vocabulary.example: Protecting the wetlands means protecting the habitat of countless birds and fish.
vocabulary.translation: 保护湿地就是保护无数鸟类和鱼类的栖息地。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联七星岩生态报道：景区周边湿地为野生动物提供重要 habitat。

pattern.pattern: Sth fuels a(n) ... boom in ... / sth has fueled ...（某事带动了……的繁荣）
pattern.example: China's National Day holiday has fueled a tourism and culture boom, with more visitors choosing low-carbon, nature-based getaways.
pattern.translation: 中国的国庆假期带动了旅游与文化繁荣，越来越多游客选择低碳、亲近自然的出行方式。
pattern.usage: fuel 原意为“燃料；给……加燃料”，此处作动词，比喻“推动、助长”。常用于新闻标题和经济类写作，如：Policy support has fueled a boom in green investment.（政策支持带动了绿色投资的热潮。）

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）在新闻中的运用
grammar.explanation: 新闻报道常用“have/has + 过去分词”来强调过去发生的事情对现在造成的影响或结果，或表示从过去持续到现在的情况（常与 for、since、so far、recently 等时间状语连用）。与一般过去时相比，现在完成时更突出“与现在的关联”。
examples: China has topped the gold medal table for the 12th consecutive edition.
Continued policy support has buoyed China's full-year growth outlook.

pronunciation.tips: 重音落在第二个音节 stay 上，读作 sə-STAY-nə-bl。开头音节弱读为 /sə/，不要读成 /suː/；第三、四音节 /nəbl/ 读得轻而快，结尾的 -able 发 /əbl/。注意与 maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ 共享 /steɪn/ 的发音。
examples: Sustainable tourism helps protect the environment for future generations.
We need sustainable solutions to balance growth and conservation.

reading.title: Greener Getaways: China's Holiday Travel Boom Goes Green
reading.content:
During this year's National Day holiday, millions of Chinese travellers hit the road — and many of them chose greener ways to travel. Scenic areas such as the Seven Star Crags in Zhaoqing, Guangdong, where limestone peaks rise from clear lakes, welcomed an influx of visitors eager to enjoy pristine nature. To keep the environment in good condition, local authorities have set visitor limits, promoted low-carbon transport and strengthened ecological conservation around the wetlands.

Data from the holiday show that eco-friendly tourism is booming. Instead of rushing through crowded landmarks, more people now prefer slow travel and long-stay 'sojourn living' in quiet scenic towns. Such habits place less strain on fragile habitats and help prevent environmental degradation.

Policy support for renewable energy and green infrastructure is also brightening the full-year growth outlook. As one saying goes, the Earth is what we all have in common — and protecting it begins with the choices we make on every trip.
reading.translation:
今年国庆假期，数以百万计的中国游客出行，其中许多人选择了更绿色的旅行方式。广东肇庆七星岩等风景名胜区——石灰岩山峰从清澈湖水中拔地而起——迎来了大批渴望亲近原始自然的游客。为保护环境，当地有关部门设置了游客限流、推广低碳交通，并加强了湿地周边的生态保护。

假期数据显示，生态旅游正蓬勃发展。如今更多人不再匆忙打卡拥挤的景点，而是偏爱慢旅行，并在安静的风景小镇体验长期旅居。这些习惯对脆弱栖息地的压力更小，有助于防止环境退化。

可再生能源和绿色基础设施方面的政策支持也让全年经济增长前景更加明朗。正如一句名言所说：地球是我们所有人的共同家园——而保护它，始于我们每一次出行中的选择。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily《Seven Star Crags, Zhaoqing, Guangdong》《National Day holiday fuels tourism, culture boom》《Policy support buoys full-year growth outlook》《Sojourn living: a fast-growing new sector》及 CGTN《Numbers behind China's National Day holiday》等真实新闻素材，围绕环境与可持续发展主题改写，用于英语学习目的。
